lines: Zindagi jab bhi teri bazm mein laati hai hamein
couplets.en: Whenever life brings us into your company.

lines: Ye zameen chaand se behtar nazar aati hai hamein
couplets.en: This earth seems lovelier to us than the moon.

lines: Surkh phoolon se mahak uthti hain dil ki raahein
couplets.en: Red blossoms scent the paths of the heart.

lines: Din dhale yoon teri aawaaz bulaati hai hamein
couplets.en: As daylight fades, your voice calls to us.

lines: Ye zameen chaand se behtar nazar aati hai hamein
couplets.en: This earth seems lovelier to us than the moon.

lines: Yaad teri kabhi dastak, kabhi sargoshi se
couplets.en: The memory of you comes sometimes as a knock, sometimes as a whisper.

lines: Raat ke pichhle pahar roz jagaati hai hamein
couplets.en: It wakes us each night in the hours before dawn.

lines: Ye zameen chaand se behtar nazar aati hai hamein
couplets.en: This earth seems lovelier to us than the moon.

lines: Har mulaaqaat ka anjaam judaai kyun hai
couplets.en: Why must every meeting end in parting?

lines: Ab to har waqt yahi baat sataati hai hamein
couplets.en: Now that question gives us no rest.

lines: Zindagi jab bhi teri bazm mein laati hai hamein
couplets.en: Whenever life brings us into your company.
